sentences.text: Heard Sri Kaushlendra Tewari, learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Gyanendra Singh, learned A.G.A. for the State and Sri R.K. Singh for the complainant and perused the records.

2. The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No.245 of 2022, under Sections 419, 420, 467, 468, 471 I.P.C., registered at Police Station Paraspur,
District Gonda.

3. The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of an F.I.R. lodged on 10.09.2022 by the applicant's husband, in furtherance of an application under Section 156(3) Cr.P.C. stating that the applicant had worked as Anganbadi Karyakatri between 2005 to 2008, on the basis of a forged High School Certificate by replacing her correct date of birth 15.07.1989, with 03.11.1983.
4.

In the affidavit filed in support of bail application, it has been stated that the applicant is an Smt. Uma Devi vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko. on 11 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/144250419/
1 innocent woman, and the FIR has been lodged by the applicant's husband because of estranged relations between them, due to which the applicant has lodged an FIR bearing Case Crime No.65 of 2017 under Sections 498A, 32, 504, 506 IPC, 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station Paraspur,
District Gonda and a petition under Section 156(3) Cr.P.C. bearing Case No.300 of 2019 in the Court of Principal Judge, Family Court, Gonda.

entities.text: Uma Devi vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko
entities.label: PRECEDENT

entities.text: Court of Principal Judge, Family Court, Gonda
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: It has been further been stated that the alleged offence was committed between the years 2005 and 2008 during which the applicant was minor and upon attaining the age of majority, she herself had resigned from service.
The FIR has been lodged 17 years after the incident.
5. The learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for bail but he could not dispute the aforesaid aspects of the matter.

6. Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the fact that the applicant is a woman having no criminal history; and she is languishing in jail since 02.07.2023 and without making any observation, which may affect the merits of the case, I am of the view that the aforesaid facts are sufficient for making out a case for enlargement of the applicant on bail in the aforesaid crime.
7. Accordingly, this bail application stands allowed.
Smt. Uma Devi vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.
